## Summary

Describe the focused change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] Software previews regenerate
- [ ] Fresh installation or upgrade path tested when applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No preset personal location or secrets added
- [ ] Hardware claims include repeatable evidence

## Screenshots or hardware evidence

Attach preview images, photographs, and sanitized logs when applicable.

## Rollback

Explain how to reverse this change.
